verdict.rationale: Homebrew ships explicit headless/automation primitives: `NONINTERACTIVE=1` for unattended installs, no-sudo operation, `brew bundle`/Brewfile for scripted reproducible dependency installs (used like package.json/Gemfile in CI), analytics opt-out, and even root-as-console-user support for MDM/Jamf automation — all standard in CI pipelines. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of Homebrew actually running inside CI systems (e.g. GitHub Actions logs) and confirmation of stability/determinism at scale, since community threads mostly discuss interactive-upgrade surprises rather than CI-specific reliability.
